## Giovanni Cuttica

Hi! My name is Giovanni, and I am a PhD candidate in Economics, specializing in Public Economics, at the University of Ferrara (Italy). I'll submit my thesis by October 2026, and - if everything goes well - I'll defend my dissertation in spring 2027.

You can read more about my background and find my CV on the [About Me](about.qmd) page.

### Research Interests
I have three streams of research. 

- The first one is about public economics and political economy, with a particular focus on local government behavior and fiscal federalism. 

- The second one is about regional economics, with a particular focus on the dynamics of regional development and the role of public institutions in managing resources. 

- The third one is more about applying "econometric stuff" to better understand the causal relationships between variables in economics and social sciences.

You can find a list of my publications and working papers on the [Papers and Projects](papers.qmd) page.
